DialogueContent: Oh, I heard someone new showed up on the island. I am Betty - nice to meet you.
So… what brings you to a place like this?
Wait, YOU want to clean the island? Alright - if that's your thing.
But honestly? Feels like fighting a losing battle.
The pollution? Sure, it sucks. But let's be real - picking up trash isn't exactly my style.
I used to care. Guess I got tired of hoping things would change.
Huh? Oh - hi! Marley mentioned someone washed up on the beach. I'm Ollie. It's great to meet you in person!!
Really? You want to stay and help clean this place up? That's... a big task.
But that's really thoughtful of you - I didn't see that coming.
Oh—no offense! It's not that you look like you wouldn't care, it's just... It's been like this for ages.
I honestly didn't think anyone would actually do something about it.
Still, I'd love to see this island turn around.
I've got my hands full right now, but if you prove you're serious... who knows? Maybe I'll pitch in too.
Yo! Haven't seen you around before. Stoked to meet ya, friend!
#Whoa, you're here to clean up the trash? That's so rad! Cleaner water means smoother waves - totally stoked!
Oh! Totally spaced—name's Noah. I moved here to chill, soak in the sun, you feel me?$ Riding waves is, like, my whole thing, hahaha.
Not gonna lie, the trash is killing the vibe… but I'd still rather have sand in my shorts than clean it all up.
§Feels like, way too much effort, y'know?
Oh! You're finally awake. Are you alright? I found you washed up on the beach yesterday.
That storm must've done quite a number on your boat.
Anyway, I can help you fix it — but first, let me check your condition.
Try walking around a bit. Once you feel ready, come talk to me.
System: Press W A S D to move around and E to interact.
Ah, great! Looks like all your limbs are in perfect working order! ...Your boat wasn't quite so lucky.
I managed to get it seaworthy again while you were out, but let's just say… she won't be winning any races.
With the right upgrades, though, she could be faster than a flying fish!
Because lucky you- you're standing in front of the most outstanding Engineer on the entire island! ...Also, the only one.
Let's start from the beginning. My name's Marley, and you're on the ___ Islands. The most beautiful place in the ___ Seas…
Or, well, it used to be. Now, it's just a shadow of its former self.
Why? Pollution, my friend. The grass used to be lush, the palm trees thriving...
and you could walk barefoot without worrying about stepping on glass or sharp plastic. But things changed.
Most villagers left, because they could not take it anymore. I stayed. I still believe it can be saved.
I even build a machine that can re- and upcycle materials in seconds! But I'm too old to clean up the whole island on my own.
What's that? You want to help me? Really?! Ahh! I've been waiting for someone like you! A responsible youngster with a spark of hope!
As a thank-you, I'll upgrade your ship for free - just bring me the materials I need!
The machine? Oh, yes - yes! Let me give you a quick rundown. It's a Recycler and an Upcycler in one!
Just toss in any trash you find around the island, and it'll break it down into base components.
You can then use those to craft new items- useful ones! Isn't it amazing?
First, could you pick up the items lying on the ground? You'll need them to try the machine out.
Now, walk over to the Cycler's display. There, you'll see options to either recycle or upcycle materials.
Start by placing trash into the Recycler to break it down into raw materials.
Then, use the Upcycler tab to turn those materials into useful new items by combining different materials.
Time to recycle and upcycle! Kekeke!
Alright, I think you're all set! Go explore the island, meet some friends, and don't hesitate to come back if you want to upgrade your boat.
And- thank you again, truly. You’re making a difference.

+What's up?”, ”Oh, I don't need anything right now. Thanks for asking, though!
$Marley is such a valuable person for our small community! And his wife, Lizzy, is the sweetest lady.
I heard they traveled the world together when they were young and helped people and animals in need.
Now I sometimes bring Marley something to eat and help him clean his house.

I have a pen pal overseas. I have never met them, but we have been writing to each other for around 4 months now! I have mentioned you in my last letter.
It's so fun imagining who they are…”, “What if they are a pirate or a king! That would be so cool…
How is the cleaning going?”, “Me? It's going good!
